compatibility_statement: Obelisk v1.0 stable must mean the complete public SDK contract for plugin authors, not a runtime/core-first RC or internal-runtime stability milestone. The current post-RC tree may inventory v1 surfaces without claiming v1.0 completion.

stable_release_contract.meaning: v1.0 stable is the complete public SDK contract for plugin authors.
claim_requires: v1_completion_required is true in this manifest
every v1_sdk_completion_blocker is promoted or explicitly named as excluded/post-v1 in the v1 release statement
the release ships a reviewed SDK compatibility statement based on docs/SDK_V1_COMPATIBILITY.md and docs/public_sdk_surfaces.json

global_rules: Public SDK surfaces must use copied C ABI payloads or metadata-only descriptors.
Every promoted surface must have ABI or installed-SDK consumer coverage, lifecycle cleanup rules, privacy boundaries, and promotion evidence.
Promoted callback surfaces must be capability_gated, append_only_abi, owner_token_handle_registration, owner_scoped_unregister, plugin_owner_cleanup, and no_ue_internals_in_public_abi.

Raw UE pointers, raw ProcessEvent params, raw FString storage, FName/GObjects indices, ArkApi offsets, MSVC layouts, vtables, lookup handles, mutation, and return override authority are not public SDK contracts.
promotion_requirements: Named capability bit or documented metadata-only reason.
Append-only C ABI fields with abi_version and struct_size where data crosses the plugin boundary.
Owner-token handle registration and owner-scoped unregister for callback surfaces.
ABI layout tests and SDK consumer or installed-SDK consumer tests.
Second-source or equivalent static/offline evidence when UE gameplay data is exposed.
Explicit exclusions for identity, lookup, mutation, return override, raw UE internals, and privacy-sensitive data.
release_guardrails: The manifest is documentary until a release gate explicitly packages it.
stable_release_contract.claim_allowed must stay false while v1_completion_required is false.
A v1.0 stable claim must mean the complete public SDK contract for plugin authors, not runtime/core-first RC readiness or internal runtime stability alone.
v1_completion_required must stay false until docs/STATUS.md claims a complete v1 SDK.
Every v1_sdk_completion_blocker must be promoted or explicitly named as excluded/post-v1 in the v1 release statement before v1_completion_required can become true.
Installed SDK package/component validation, including CMake COMPONENTS SDK, is package-shape evidence only and is not a v1.0 completion marker.
Identity/principal, permissions/admin, and commands/replies are an ordered v1 dependency chain; if any of those surfaces remains blocked, planning, or post-v1, v1_completion_required must stay false.

That dependency chain must not be documented as permissions/admin being the immediate next public slice; groups, grants, admin actions, and mutation authority remain excluded unless a future promotion gate explicitly says otherwise.

Before identity/principal is promoted, release-supported Plugin Hub seeds are limited to lifecycle/config/logging, descriptors, and process-local timers; those pre-identity release-supported seeds are not enough for v1 completion, and passive chat parsing and plugin-local routing remain promoted-experimental-only.
Plugin Hub seed docs and installed examples must not be used as v1 completion evidence.

Lifecycle/config/logging foundation does not satisfy lifecycle ops recovery demand; plugin watchdogs, hot reload, process restart orchestration, server recovery, operator reload commands, and restart-state semantics must be promoted separately or explicitly excluded/post-v1.

Umbrella blockers do not imply broad module coverage; dino, tribe, buff/status, chat send/broadcast, player progression/engrams, economy, mobility, and operator ingress/storage must each be promoted as narrow copied C ABI surfaces or explicitly excluded by name in the v1 release statement.

Player identity/principal evidence does not unlock operator ingress/storage; operator_ingress_storage remains a separate blocked/post-v1 surface until secret-safe ingress, storage schema/migration, queue drain, audit, encoding, and lifecycle policy are promoted or explicitly excluded.

Player identity/principal planning requires a non-protected complete core evidence pack plus a reviewed UFunction reflection-inventory pack; an offline ShooterGameServer binary, copied core, manual roots, or direct core/bin planning alone is not public SDK or promotion evidence.
Every promoted-experimental-only surface must be promoted, downgraded to planning/post-v1, or explicitly excluded before v1_completion_required can become true.
GameplayPolicyEvent and ChatMessageEvent are copied-data seeds only; separately or together they must not be described as v1-complete, v1.0 stable, or sufficient to turn on v1_completion_required.
No surface may be listed as promoted unless its status is promoted.
post_v1_or_excluded_surfaces must exactly match surfaces whose status is post-v1 or excluded.
No excluded, debug-only, planning, or post-v1 surface may declare a non-empty public_contract.
docs/public_gameplay_events.json remains the detailed evidence source for GameplayPolicyEvent and ChatMessageEvent backing target sets.
